claimUnits: manufacturer_de (moderate): 'für feuchtigkeitsbedürftiges Haar'; 'versorgt sowohl die Kopfhaut, als auch die Längen für 72 Stunden mit der nötigen Feuchtigkeit' (names the scalp but no E2 dry-scalp state - not a qualifying dry unit); 'ganz ohne zu Beschweren'; 'Haartyp: Bedürftiges & Trockenes Haar'

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 - defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 with two prominent amphoteric buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine@5, Coco-Betaine@10) and no reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: see rationale (counter-signals recorded there; convention value unchanged by claims, 3.2)

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met - early silicone Dimethicone@6, cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@8, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate@3 and a deliberate humectant entry Sodium Hyaluronate@13; supporting late Amodimethicone@23. Counter-signal: the humectant is a single trace hyaluronate; moderate is the neighbor.

wLine.plausibility: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) no cleansing surfactant (Trideceth-n and Steareth-6 are in no C3 cleansing class), no alkanolamide (Cocamide MEA@9 is before it) and no pearlizing wax after it before the cap

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate - early dimethicone with guar coacervate plus a late amodimethicone
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate - C1 SLES chassis with two betaine buffers
weightPotential.counterevidence: Dimethicone is early (@6, before the guar), which argues toward high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W1 applies: (a) C1 sulfate chassis with prominent buffers, cleansingStrength moderate; (b) deposition is exactly silicone + cationic guar + late amodimethicone; (c) no further persistent family converges (no payload lipid, second cationic, film former or protein) and no rich architecture.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W1's settled set without W-RICH or any further converging family is moderate; the effective SLES/betaine reset bounds the silicone/guar deposit. Not low: the early silicone + guar system is plausible enough that calling it lightweight would understate residue.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W1 set in an effective C1 chassis (6.7 W1).

dandruffSupport.rationale: No recognized anti-dandruff active; Salicylic Acid@20 alone does not upgrade the property (Section 11).

focusPrimary.rationale: General: moisture positioning over a nonspecific formula (F1).

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; 'glänzendes ... Haar' is an outcome of the silicone route (F2, holdout-v3 precedent).

usageRole.rationale: Regular: no frequency wording ('täglich strapaziert' describes the hair, not use).
usageRole.decisionTrace: Default regular considered; trigger none; no losing trigger.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: no E2 sensitive or dry-scalp state is named ('versorgt ... die Kopfhaut mit Feuchtigkeit' names no condition).
